title: Google signs 3.6 GW nuclear power deal with Constellation Energy — largest corporate clean energy agreement on record
summary: Google announced a landmark 20-year power purchase agreement with Constellation Energy for 3.6 GW of nuclear power to supply its AI data centers, surpassing any previous corporate clean energy deal. The deal involves multiple Constellation nuclear facilities across the U.S. and begins delivering power from 2026–2027. Constellation Energy (CEG) shares surged on the announcement.
why: Sets a new benchmark for hyperscaler AI energy procurement; nuclear confirmed as the preferred always-on baseload for large-scale AI compute; directly supports AI chip demand thesis and hyperscaler capex cycle; raises structural demand outlook for uranium and nuclear operators globally; Google Cloud energy strategy has HK-listed implications via competitive cloud dynamics

title: Fed releases September 16 FOMC minutes; dot plot shows strong majority expect at least one more 2026 hike; October 27–28 meeting in focus
summary: The Federal Reserve released minutes from its September 16, 2026 meeting, at which policymakers unanimously raised rates 25bps to 3.75–4.00%, the first hike since 2023 under Chair Kevin Warsh. The minutes show most officials view further tightening as appropriate if inflation stays elevated. Goldman Sachs and Bank of America each forecast consecutive October and December hikes. The next FOMC meeting is October 27–28; market pricing for an October hike stands near 50%.
why: Fed policy is the dominant macro driver for all three tracked markets today; minutes released this afternoon are fresh and market-moving; October hike debate is heightened by the September payrolls miss (29K); rising 10Y yield (~5.27%) compresses equity multiples; heightened rate volatility expands put premiums and creates sell-put opportunities on rate-sensitive names

title: 港股10月6日收涨约1%，恒生科技指数领涨，生物科技板块创年内新高
summary: 10月6日香港股市收盘温和上涨，恒生指数收涨约1%，恒生科技指数涨幅居前，AI及医药生物科技板块表现亮眼，生物科技指数创年内新高。A股国庆长假期间，港股作为中国资产唯一开市窗口受到较多关注。
why: A股国庆休市期间港股走势是节后10月8日复盘的重要参照；生物科技创年内新高意味着资金持续轮动至医药赛道；对持有0700/9988/3690/9992等港股标的以及相关sell put操作有直接参考价值

title: U.S. September 2026 nonfarm payrolls +29,000 — biggest miss since 2021; unemployment rate rises to 4.3%
summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported September 2026 nonfarm payrolls of only 29,000, far below the consensus of approximately 150,000 and the weakest monthly reading since 2021. The unemployment rate ticked up to 4.3%. The severe miss fueled a debate over whether the Fed can proceed with an October rate hike; prediction markets imply roughly 50/50 odds.
why: Largest payrolls miss in years; direct input into the October 27–28 FOMC rate decision; still_developing because today's FOMC September minutes (released Oct 7) directly address this data and further Fed commentary ahead of the Oct 27–28 meeting will be shaped by it; rate uncertainty creates elevated volatility favorable to sell-put strategies on quality names

title: Tesla Q3 2026 deliveries: 486,532 vehicles above expectations; Q3 earnings call set for October 21
summary: Tesla reported Q3 2026 deliveries of 486,532 vehicles and production of 510,890 units, beating analyst consensus of approximately 460,000. Model Y and Model 3 accounted for the majority of deliveries. The strong beat eases near-term demand concerns amid competition from BYD and other Chinese EVs. Q3 earnings are scheduled for October 21, 2026; Goldman Sachs raised its TSLA price target following the delivery beat on October 6.
why: Tesla is a sell-put candidate in the strategy; delivery beat shifts Q3 earnings sentiment positive heading into Oct 21 earnings; Goldman upgrade makes this still-developing; FSD/Cybercab regulatory and volume developments could add upside narrative into earnings; TSLA put premiums elevated ahead of the earnings catalyst
